recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. Revisit DiagnosticReport.code/report-codes only through FHIR-50603 or another final Applied/Published issue if OO decides to refine the LOINC subset or value-set description.
issue_request: FHIR-20337 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change request raised against STU3 DiagnosticReport. It noted that a DiagnosticReport category value-set definition said it included LOINC codes relating to Diagnostic Observations while the compose included all LOINC, and proposed wording that the value set currently contained all of LOINC. The final resolution said other changes had addressed the concern and no further updates were needed.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-20337 source commit or current source reference was found. Current source shows the issue's LOINC value-set concern is no longer attached to DiagnosticReport.category: DiagnosticReport.category has an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/diagnostic-service-sections, while DiagnosticReport.code has the preferred binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/report-codes. The 2021 source rework already contained that category/code separation.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists diagnosticreport as an active resource, so the DiagnosticReport source folder is in build scope. The category value set includes HL7 V2 table 0074 and is internally consistent. The LOINC report-codes value set is no longer all LOINC because later Applied issue FHIR-32754 and commit 7a7b280 added STATUS, ORDER_OBS, and CLASSTYPE filters; FHIR-32754 is already represented by an AutoFHIR audit on the combined branch. FHIR-50603 is a later Triaged concern about narrowing DiagnosticReport.code/report-codes and is not a final source-edit decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Applying the original proposed all-LOINC wording would now be wrong for report-codes, and DiagnosticReport.category's current binding and value-set definition are consistent.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied core issue changed the LOINC report-codes value set that FHIR-20337's description appears to have referred to; it is already audited on the combined branch.
Earlier Published category cardinality issue explains multiple DiagnosticReport.category schemes, but it did not require this reconciliation to change the category value set.
Later Triaged request about narrowing DiagnosticReport.code/report-codes; not a final in-scope reversal.
